messages:
deploy-bot: Promotion blocked for release v2.14.2 - artifact lock on build 98765, reason: remote-cache: blob not found. auto-retry scheduled in 10m. https://ci.company/reports/98765

alex: saw the deploy-bot alert. is this the cache migration fallout or a transient registry glitch?

devon: looks like the remote cache backend dropped a shard during maintenance. restore step failing with 429 and `ERROR: blob not found` in the logs. reproducible on the same artifact id.

mira: ugh. we just migrated TTLs last night. current options: 1) wait for cache to repopulate (unknown timing), 2) reupload artifacts to registry and force promotion, 3) rollback to last-green and hold the window.

sam: adding that e2e run is flaky too — two failed tests `session-timeout` and `db-seed-race`. Even if we get the artifact, canary might flake.

alex: prefer reupload + canary with stricter rollout (1% -> 10% -> 100%) to reduce blast radius. If reupload fails or canary shows regressions, rollback plan in place.

devon: I can push a pipeline patch to detect cache-miss and trigger artifact reupload fallback. quick code: ``if cache_restore.failed: upload(artifact); set_cache_marker(artifact)``. Pushing a patch to `ci/pipelines/promote.yml` now.

ci-bot: Job created: ci/reupload-artifact-98765 #1234 by devon.

prod-oncall: we have a customer-facing change window until 18:00 UTC. if we can't confirm stable canary by 15:30 UTC, we should revert this promotion and open an incident.

mira: agreed. propose timeline: reupload attempt (T+5m), canary rollout start (T+20m), smoke tests + perf checks (T+40m). rollback cutoff 15:30.

alex: I'll prepare rollback notes and scripts: `promote --rollback-to tag:v2.14.1 && notify(customers)` and update release notes with the hold reason.

devon: reupload succeeded -> registry returned digest sha256:abc123. triggering promote with cache-bypass flag.

deploy-bot: Starting canary rollout for v2.14.2 -> 1%.

sam: smoke tests passing on canary 1/1, latency ok. small flake in `session-timeout` but non-blocking.

mira: increase to 10%. monitoring traces for errors and token usage.

prod-oncall: monitoring dashboards look good for 10 minutes. go to 100% when you confirm no regressions in the next checks.

alex: rolling to 100% now.

deploy-bot: Promotion completed successfully for release v2.14.2 (build 98765). changelog updated and release notes published. :tada:

devon: filing a follow-up PR to add automatic reupload fallback and a note about migration TTLs to the runbook.

mira: created runbook task: `eng-releases#142` to adjust cache migration steps and add post-migration verification.

alex: thanks team. closing thread, but keep an eye on canary dashboards for 2 hours.
